data.name: Kaabir
data.gender_notes: Kaabir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Kaabir means 'great' or 'big'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history as it was the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Kaab ibn Malik Al-Ansari was one of the earliest converts to Islam and played a crucial role in the Battle of Uhud. The name Kaabir carries the meaning “Big, Grand, Great” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaabir usually hope their child will grow to embody big, grand, great and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies greatness in faith and actions.
data.etymology: Kaabir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Big, Grand, Great.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaabir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
